subject: Re: Status: DiscoFuse repro done, insertion drift on long rewrites
body:
Tereza, all — decisions for the pre-read.

Ratings from the April round (612 rated pairs, decent inter-rater agreement per Fumiko) confirm the pattern: short rewrites score 4.2+ on both scales, long rewrites drop to 3.4 on meaning preservation.

So the launch-review pre-read proposes shipping assisted rewrite scoped to short edits — where the tagging-plus-insertion decomposition is demonstrably strong — and holds long-form rewrites for a constrained-insertion variant in Q3. That's a scope cut and I'll own the messaging: better a sharp small feature than a mushy big one.

Maren, include the rating tool's agreement stats in the appendix; they preempt the "are the ratings real" question. Pre-read goes out May 6 for the May 8 review.

Thank you — this one moved fast and stayed honest.

Priya
